<a name="introduction"></a>
## 🔬 Project Overview 

This is an end-to-end data engineering project on the Azure cloud. Here, I ingested data from an on-premise SQL Server to Azure Data Lake using Data Factory, performed transformations using Databricks and Spark, loaded the data into Synapse Analytics, and built reports using Power BI. I also used Azure Active Directory (AAD) and Azure Key Vault for data security and governance.

### 💾 Dataset

**AdventureWorks** is a sample OLTP database from Microsoft that models the operations of a fictional manufacturing multinational, Adventure Works Cycles.

> For this project, I used the **Lightweight (LT) data**: a pared-down version of the OLTP sample. [Download here](https://github.com/Microsoft/sql-server-samples/releases/download/adventureworks/AdventureWorksLT2022.bak)

### 🎯 Project Goals

- Establish a secure connection between an on-premise SQL server and the Azure cloud.
- Ingest tables dynamically into Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.
- Apply data cleaning and transformation using Azure Databricks (PySpark).
- Load the cleaned, structured data into Azure Synapse Analytics for warehousing.
- Create interactive data visualizations and reports with Microsoft Power BI.
- Implement Azure Active Directory (AAD) and Azure Key Vault for robust security and governance.

<a name="key-insights"></a>
## 🕵️ Key Insights

- 💸 **Total Revenue by Product Category**
  - *Touring Bikes* lead revenue generation at 32%, followed by *Road Bikes* (26%) and *Mountain Bikes* (24%).
 
- 🌍 **Sales by Country**
  - **#1:** The United Kingdom, with 278 total sales and $572,000 in revenue.
  - **#2:** The United States, with 264 total sales and $383,810 in revenue.

- 🚻 **Revenue by Gender**
  - 81% of revenue is generated by Male customers.
  - 19% of revenue is generated by Female customers.

<a name="project-architecture"></a>
## 🏛️ Project Architecture

The complete end-to-end architecture is visualized below:

![AzurePipeline-Hamagistral](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/ebb0f88b-917f-4a6a-be6b-ddf6093ad793)

<a name="data-ingestion"></a>
### 📤 Data Ingestion
- Connected the on-premise SQL Server to Azure Data Factory using a Self-Hosted Integration Runtime.

![image](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/b57debac-28c2-4928-8640-676643e0177c)

- Set up the **Resource group** with all necessary services (Key Vault, Storage Account, Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics).

![ressource-group](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/62990af9-db6e-4712-81bf-61420835bb99)

- Migrated tables dynamically from on-premise SQL Server to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 using a metadata-driven ADF pipeline (`Lookup` + `ForEach` + `Copy` activities).

![df-pipeline](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/21ed74aa-8bf4-46c5-952c-4dc9f14dc9fb)
![image](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/2b9855a9-9ad7-4ac3-8076-70762ef0f3bc)


<a name="data-transformation"></a>
### ⚙️ Data Transformation
- Mounted Azure Blob Storage to Databricks to retrieve raw data from the Data Lake.
- Used a Spark Cluster in Azure Databricks to clean, transform, and join tables.
- Saved the cleaned data in the efficient Delta format, ready for analysis.

![image](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/11b7fb4e-0013-4a9f-a791-ab2a2789f774)

<a name="data-loading"></a>
### 📥 Data Loading
- Used Azure Synapse Analytics to load the refined Delta tables.
- Created an SQL database and external tables that read directly from the Delta files in the data lake, enabling a serverless SQL warehouse.

![synapse-pipeline](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/99a8c7cd-1a6f-4ec9-b35d-2e171d3be87b)
![db-synapse](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/b601eb00-efe1-44d9-8de6-8f001176d549)

<a name="data-reporting"></a>
### 📊 Data Reporting
- Connected Microsoft Power BI to the Azure Synapse SQL endpoint.
- Built an interactive dashboard to visualize key metrics like revenue by category, sales by country, and revenue by gender.

![PowerBI-dashboard](https://github.com/Hamagistral/Azure-AW/assets/66017329/30bb3c61-1503-42a3-8b03-cd7c3da7bb82)

<a name="technologies-used"></a>
### 🛠️ Technologies Used

- **Data Source**: On-Premise SQL Server
- **Orchestration**: Azure Data Factory
- **Data Lake**: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
- **Transformation**: Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake)
- **Data Warehouse**: Azure Synapse Analytics
- **Reporting**: Microsoft Power BI
- **Security**: Azure Key Vault & Azure Active Directory
